title: 31st sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/31/2024).
Preliminary debate on the bill amending Law No. 12/2016 (Criminal Procedure Act), submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Unfinished business: continuation of the debate on the Urban Development Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Vilingili MP Azim Abdul Azeez.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to debate a private member's bill amending the Criminal Procedure Act and continue the debate on the government's Urban Development Bill.
